edge_check.note: author boxes are loose and block 2 is keyed off by one; flags are for review, not errors

meta.frame: pixels of site/img/p/diary1.jpg, [x0,y0,x1,y1], x1/y1 exclusive, origin top-left; analysis runs in a sheared frame and is mapped back (about +-1 px)

parameters.threshold_method: Otsu split of the sheared page histogram outside the rule bands
parameters.x_height_source: median of field 7 of pages[].x (author line records) * ih
parameters.gap_rule_chosen_by: best word-line match on these same 22 lines (optimistic; not held out)
parameters.rule_residue: components <=3 px tall centred on a rule are dropped
parameters.mark_rule: dot/period: area<=0.12*xh^2 and size<=0.5*xh; comma-like: area<=0.45*xh^2, centroid at/below the rule, w<=0.7*xh, h<=1.1*xh
parameters.glyph_merge: marks merge into a host they sit over/under; nested or near-touching (<=3 px) fragments merge
parameters.row_assignment: centroid vs rule rows (band up to rule + 0.3*period) only decides which rule rows carry text; ink ownership is the seam partition (meta.partition)

stanza.basis: stanza = block order in j.json; setbacks need only line boxes

line.basis: 22 ink rows = 22 lines; line boxes and regions from the seam partition (every ink pixel owned by one line); box rectangles of neighbours still overlap, regions do not

word.basis: word boxes are usable crops; text is attached only on lines whose box count equals the token count and that passed eye review

glyph.basis: ink-component crops are usable pictures; they are NOT letters (counts do not match)

word_part.basis: letters cannot be honestly aligned to glyph boxes: whole-line letter/glyph counts match on 4 of 22 lines

eye_review.reason: line 13: box count equals token count (4 for 4) but, re-checked by eye after the seam partition, the seam still cuts three descender loops of line 12 at the neck and hands them to line 13 (one inside its first word box, two inside its fourth), and the upper bowl of the last letter group is split with line 12; text withdrawn until the author traces seam waypoints (seam-waypoints-diary1.json)

partition.method: min-cost seam per adjacent text-line pair (dynamic programming over the sheared ink mask), see segment.py partition()
partition.frame: seam values are boundary rows of the sheared frame (rows < seam belong to the upper line); each line's `region` polygon is the page-frame image of its two seams (page y = Y - pad + slope * x)
partition.region_rule: a page pixel belongs to a region when its centre has top <= y < bottom; regions of different lines never overlap by construction (seams strictly ordered)
partition.tuned_in_sample: band depth 1.6*xh (checked against the deepest single-line descender measured on this page), ascender 53.7 px (the tallest ascender measured on this page), step, straightness and centring were fixed after looking at these same 22 lines; no held-out page was used

waypoints.note: author-traced seam constraints, data not code; none supplied for this build

before_after.box_overlap_note: box rectangles in the page frame still overlap between lines (a 37 px descender plus a 54 px ascender exceeds the 57.7 px pitch, and the 1.25 degree tilt adds about 22 px); only regions are disjoint

notes: glyph = ink component group, not a letter; letters are spaced widely and some join or split
marks (commas, periods, dots) are listed per line in 'marks' and never form words
text appears only where a count check passed; 'text_basis' documents the line-level mapping
match rates are optimistic: the gap rule, the threshold and the seam parameters were picked on these same 22 lines
author line boxes for block 2: keys 2-1 and 2-2 hold the boxes of lines 2 and 3; line 1 has none (see author_box_* fields)
